summary.name: Stack Overflow Podcast #111
summary.one_liner: A June 2017 Stack Overflow Podcast episode in which members of the SRE team discuss building and maintaining Stack Overflow and the Stack Exchange network.
use_cases: Learning how a large Q&A site runs its infrastructure
Hearing SRE team practices and culture firsthand
Finding background on system administration books by Tom Limoncelli
Listening to a discussion of an industry incident review
summary.what_it_does: This is a podcast episode recorded at Stack Overflow HQ in NYC with three members of the company's SRE team: Tom Limoncelli, Mark Henderson, and Jason Harvey. They discuss how Stack Overflow and the Stack Exchange network are built and maintained, and how Stack Overflow differs from other SRE teams, noting it is not in the cloud. The episode also includes a segment called Failure is Not an Option, a discussion of a database destruction incident, and a light-hearted listener question segment. The page lists links to the Joel on Software post, Web Pages That Suck, and Tom's book The Practice of System and Network Administration.
notable: Special SRE-focused episode with three SRE team members as guests
Discussion of Stack Overflow running off the cloud, unlike many SRE teams
Links to Tom Limoncelli's book The Practice of System and Network Administration
caveats: Episode is from 2017 and may be outdated
Page notes the SRE team is hiring and the episode includes promotional content
Free podcast audio is implied, but the page does not state a price explicitly
